Ingredients:
Aqua, Glycerin, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Squalane, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Cetearyl Alcohol, Dimethicone, Butylene Glycol, Phytosteryl Oleate, Cetearyl Olivate, Sorbitan Olivate, Tocopheryl Acetate, Glyceryl Glucoside, Hydroxyacetophenone, 1,2-Hexanediol, Panthenol, Polyacrylamide, Cetearyl Glucoside, C13-14 Isoparaffin, Ectoin, Phytosterols, Laureth-7.

Efficacy:
Whitening, repairing, moisturizing. Shea butter and butylene glycol are rich in antioxidant components such as vitamin E and vitamin C, which can effectively resist the damage of free radicals to the skin and slow down the process of skin aging. Free radicals are one of the main factors leading to skin aging, which will damage the structure and function of skin cells, causing problems such as wrinkles and sagging skin. The antioxidant components in shea butter can neutralize free radicals and protect skin cells from damage, thus maintaining the youthful state of the skin. It can also enhance the skin’s immunity, improve the skin’s resistance to environmental factors, prevent inflammation and damage caused by external stimulation, and achieve effects such as whitening and repairing.

Formula:
Aqua, Glycerin, Dimethicone, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Butylene Glycol, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Polyisobutene, Peg-7 Trimethylolpropane Coconut Ether, Sorbitan Isostearate, Betaine, Squalane, Trehalose, Hydroxyacetophenone, 1,2-Hexanediol, Allantoin, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Ergothioneine, Ectoin, Collagen.

Efficacy:
Repair, moisturize and is an effective antioxidant, mainly contains retinol and its derivatives. These ingredients perform well in skin repair and can promote the production of collagen, thus improving skin sagging and reducing wrinkles. At the same time, antioxidant ingredients such as betaine and squalane (vitamin E) can neutralize free radicals, repair inflammation and delay skin aging. In addition, external collagen has a certain water-locking and hydration effect on the skin, mainly manifested in the strong water absorption of collagen, which can have a good moisturizing effect on the skin. Through absorbed water where it will turn into collagen-like colloids, it plays an anti-aging role on the skin. Effectively moisturizing the skin and repair daily photoaging damage, and delay skin aging.

Formula:
Aqua, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Niacinamide, Hydroxyacetophenone, 1,2-Hexanediol, Tranexamic Acid, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Carboxymethyl Chitosan, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Triethanolamine, Ectoin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Xanthan Gum, Allantoin, CI 19140.

Efficacy:
Niacinamide can inhibit the production of melanin, reduce pigment spots, and make the skin whiter. Xanthan gum, etc., is good for improving the surface condition of the skin. The effect of repair, combined with sodium hyaluronate can have anti-aging effects and promote skin repair. It also can stimulate epidermal cell growth factors and promote the repair and regeneration of damaged skin. In addition, it promotes the accelerated healing of wounds so that the skin can metabolize aging cells faster thereby increase the metabolism of the skin.

Formula:
Aqua, Glyceryl Glucoside, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Caprylhydroxamic Acid, Ethylhexylglycerin, 1,2-Hexanediol, Betaine, Trehalose, Sodium Hyaluronate, Ergothioneine, Ectoin.

Efficacy:
Skin rejuvenation where water can quickly provide the necessary moisture for the skin. Relieve the discomfort of dry and tight skin and balance the pH of the skin. It strengthens the skin’s self-defense system, replenish moisture, soften the cuticle and make other skin care products easier to be absorbed. It also regulates oil and moisture and makes the skin balance the water-oil composition to have a balance tone with sea Algae sugar, etc. These ingredients can penetrate deep into the bottom layer of the skin, lock in moisture and keep the skin moist for a long time. Skin metabolism requires a large amount of water, which can increase the moisture content of the skin. Improve the problems of dryness and water shortage.

Ingredients:
Aqua, Methylpropanediol, Isononyl Isononanoate, Panthenol, Mineral Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, Glyceryl Stearate, Cetearyl Alcohol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Phytosteryl Oleate, Peg-100 Stearate, C12-15 AlkylBenzoate, CI 77891, Phenoxyethanol, Glycerin, Ophiopogon Japonicus Root Extract, Caprylhydroxamic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate, Silica, Dimethicone, Peg-30 Dipolyhydroxystearate, 1,2-Hexanediol, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Phytosterols, Caprylyl Glycol, Tocopherol, Ascorbyl Palmitate.

Moisturizing:
Provides sufficient moisture to the skin, avoids dryness, and at the same time enhances the softness and elasticity of the skin. Brightening skin tone: Through mica and other light-reflecting ingredients, makes the skin look more radiant. Evening skin tone: Slightly conceals and covers small blemishes, adjusts skin tone, makes the skin present a natural and even beauty, and can also be used as a primer for makeup.

Formula:
Aqua, Cyclopentasiloxane, Cl 77891, Butylene Glycol, Glycerin, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Cetyl Peg/Ppg-10/1 Dimethicone, Isododecan, Synthetic fluorphlogopite, Peg-10 Dimethicone, Magnesium Sulfate, Propylene Glycol Dicaprylate/Dicaprate, Disteardimonium Hectorite, Tribehenin, CI 77492, Phenoxyethanol, Aluminum Hydroxide, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, CI 77491, Tocopherol, CI 77499.

Efficacy:
Mainly used for facial makeup beauty, covering undesirable blemishes of the face, such as age spots, acne and scars. It improves the texture, color and luster of the skin, making the skin color look more natural and even and radiant. The lightweight texture and easy spreading property can easily achieve a natural bare skin makeup effect. Suitable for all types of skin, especially suitable for situations where quick makeup application or touch up is needed. It is very friendly to dry skin and can effectively moisturize and ensure long lasting makeup.

Formula:
Aqua, Glycereth-26, Betaine, PVP, 1,2-Hexanediol, Glycerin, Tremella Fuciformis Polysaccharide, Picea Excelsa Leaf Extract, Caprylhydroxamic Acid, Butylene Glycol, Propylene Glycol, Glyceryl Acrylate/Acrylic Acid Copolymer, Avena Sativa, 1,2-Hexanediol, PVM/MA Copolymer, 1,2-Hexanediol, Hydroxyacetophenone, Sodium Hyaluronate.

Efficacy:
Elevate your beauty routine with the Make-up Fixer Spray designed to deliver flawless, long-lasting results in just seconds. This ultra-fine mist forms a quick-drying film in under 10 seconds, locking in your look for up to 12 hours with smart make-up setting technology. Whether you have dry, oily, or combination skin, its skin-loving formula enhances hydration, smooths application, and boosts natural radiance without the dreaded cakey finish. Say goodbye to touch-ups and hello to a luminous, shine-enhanced complexion that stays fresh all day. Your skin, your glow—perfected.

Ingredients:
Aqua, Potassium Cocoate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Potassium Olivate, Disodium Cocoamphodiacetate, Potassium Cocoyl Hydrolyzed Oat Protein, Methyl Gluceth-20, Sodium Chloride, Sodium Cocoyl Glycinate, Fragrance, Butylene Glycol, Glycerin, Sodium Lactate, Glycine, Serine, Alanine, Valine, Isoleucine, Leucine, Proline, Threonine, Arginine, Aspartic Acid, Lysine, Histidine, Glutamic Acid, Methionine, Tryptophan, Cystine, Tyrosine, Phenoxyethanol.

Facial Cleanser:
Cleanses the skin, removes keratin, balances oil, with a large amount of amino acid cleansing formula. It feels clear and lightweight on the skin, with rich and dense foam, removing makeup residues and dirt. With multiple soothing and moisturizing essences, it carefully moisturizes the skin while cleansing, leaving the skin feeling clean and comfortable.

Formula:
Aqua, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Panthenol, Hydroxyacetophenone, 1,2-Hexanediol, Trehalose, Betaine, Ectoin, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Triethanolamine, Jojoba Wax Peg-120 Esters, Xanthan Gum, Hydroxyethylcellulose, 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid.

Efficacy:
Moisturizes and nourishes the skin. It replenishes water and locks in moisture, repairs and reduces inflammation. Panthenol is known as “the moisturizer of the skin” and a top tier ingredient in skin repair. Panthenol has strong moisturizing, repairing and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help relieve irritation and improve skin barrier function and regulate skin pH value. Butylene glycol has very extensive effects on moisturizing, can play a role in nourishing the skin, and can also quickly replenish the moisture needed by the skin, improve the dry state of the skin, and alleviate skin peeling and dandruff.
